name: Shingle Guard Roofs

hero.title: Complete roofing solutions
hero.lead: We provide roofing services for homes and businesses in Deer Park, Texas — new installations and replacements, repairs, gutters, skylights, ventilation and storm damage restoration, built for the way the weather moves through here.
hero.imageAlt: A large white house with a shingle roof and a green lawn

services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Installations, repairs and replacements for your home.
services.text: Durable, good-looking roofing for your home, with installations, repairs and replacements tailored to what the house actually needs.
services.imageAlt: A gray and white wooden house under a cloudy sky
body: Your home is your most valuable investment, and your roof is its first line of defense. We combine years of expertise with high-quality materials so the result lasts. A reliable roof does more than shield the house from the elements — it helps with energy efficiency, lifts curb appeal and gives you peace of mind year after year.

Whether you are building a new home, replacing an aging roof or need timely repairs, every project gets the same attention. From asphalt shingles and tile roofing to modern, energy-efficient systems, we tailor each installation to your home's style and your family's needs.

When something goes wrong, fast action matters. We inspect thoroughly, explain your options clearly and restore the roof with precision, then keep it going with maintenance and inspections that catch the early warning signs.

services.title: Roof Installation and Replacement
services.short: New roofs and full replacements, residential and commercial.
services.text: Installations and replacements that improve protection, energy efficiency and appearance, on homes and on commercial buildings.
services.imageAlt: Workers installing roof tiles on a new building
body: Your roof is one of the most important investments in your home or business. We assess the property, recommend materials and carry out the work with care — from residential shingle roofs to more complex commercial systems, tailored to your style, your needs and your budget.

A replacement is more than new materials. We handle every step, from removing the old roof safely to installing a system that meets current standards, and we inspect before and after so the structure, the materials and the ventilation are all right.
Roofing work can be stressful, so we keep communication clear, finish on time and leave as little disruption behind as possible.
points: Shingle roof installation, asphalt and architectural
Inspection before and after every job

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks, damaged shingles and flashing, fixed quickly.
services.text: Prompt repairs for leaks, damaged shingles and structural issues, so a small problem does not turn into an expensive one.
services.imageAlt: A roofer using a power drill on a roof
body: Even minor damage escalates when it is left alone. We assess the problem, find the source of the damage and put in a durable fix that restores the roof's integrity, on residential and commercial roofing systems alike.
Repairs are matched to the existing roof, so they stay watertight and still look right. Quality materials and precise work mean the patch blends in rather than standing out.
Beyond the immediate fix we look at what sits underneath: the structure, the drainage and the vulnerable areas that let water in.

services.title: Storm Damage
services.short: Fast response and repairs after wind, hail and heavy rain.
services.text: Fast response and expert repairs for roofs, gutters and siding after Texas storms, so the property is safe and restored quickly.
services.imageAlt: A shingle roof with shingles missing
body: Severe weather can leave a home or business open to leaks and structural damage. We assess the damage thoroughly, looking for leaks, broken shingles, compromised flashing and structural concerns, then act to stabilize the roof and protect the interior.
We use the inspection to explain the extent of the damage, help you prioritize repairs and work through the insurance considerations with you.
Every affected area is reinforced, sealed and restored with high-quality materials, so the roof is ready for the next storm rather than only patched for this one.
points: Leak detection and water damage repair
Gutter, downspout, vent and flashing repair

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Low-slope and flat roofs for businesses of all sizes.
services.text: Reliable roofing for businesses of all sizes, including low-slope and flat roofs, with as little disruption to operations as possible.
services.imageAlt: A commercial building roof with rooftop units against a blue sky
body: A commercial roof is part of your business infrastructure. We work on office buildings, retail spaces, warehouses and industrial facilities, handling new installations, complete replacements and the timely repairs that stop a small problem becoming a costly one.
Downtime is not an option, so we prioritize fast, responsive service. Whether it is a leak, storm damage or general wear, we act quickly to restore the roof while keeping your operations running.

We also look at long-term performance: energy-efficient materials, proper ventilation and routine maintenance that extends the life of the roof. Gutter systems and skylights are part of the same work.

services.title: Gutter Installation and Repair
services.text: Gutters that keep water moving and protect your foundation, with installation, repair, cleaning and replacement.
services.imageAlt: A gutter running along the roof edge of a house
body: Working gutters protect a property from water damage, erosion and foundation problems. We design and install systems that channel rainwater away from the roof and foundation, from seamless aluminum gutters to custom designs matched to the property.
On existing gutters we deal with leaks, clogs, sagging sections and storm damage, assessing the condition first and then fixing what is actually causing the trouble.
We make sure the system integrates with the soffit, fascia and downspouts, so water flows the way it should instead of pooling where it shouldn't.

services.title: Skylights and Ventilation
services.short: More natural light and better airflow.
services.text: Skylight installation and repair, roof vents and ventilation that improve light, airflow and energy efficiency.
services.imageAlt: A sloped roof with several skylights
body: Skylights bring brightness and openness to an interior. We install and repair them with proper sealing and integration into the existing roof, so the light comes in and the water stays out.

Ventilation matters just as much to the health of the roof. We assess attic airflow, install and repair ridge, soffit and attic vents, and balance the system to reduce heat build-up and stop moisture collecting.
Good ventilation lowers cooling costs, protects the structural components and extends the life of the roofing materials above them.
points: Ridge, soffit and attic vent installation

services.title: Siding, Soffit and Fascia
services.short: Exterior work that protects and lifts curb appeal.
services.text: Siding, soffit and fascia installation and repair that strengthens your home's exterior and improves how it looks.
services.imageAlt: White eaves and soffit on a building against a blue sky
body: Your home's exterior is more than a first impression. It protects the property from the elements, helps with energy efficiency and holds the whole look together. We install and repair siding in vinyl, wood, fiber cement and other modern materials.
Properly installed soffit and fascia help with ventilation, keep water out and add to the life of the roofing system. Fascia boards also carry the gutters, so they have to be sound.
Whether the siding has storm damage, aging wear or simply needs an upgrade, we handle the repair or replacement with clean lines, secure attachments and a finish that suits the house.
points: Gutter integration with soffit and fascia

about.title: Your Roof Is More Than A Covering
text: At Shingle Guard Roofs, we understand that your roof is more than a protective covering—it safeguards your family, your business, and everything inside your property. We deliver expert roofing solutions that combine durability, craftsmanship, and long-lasting performance.

Our team handles residential and commercial roof installations, replacements, and repairs with precision and care. From addressing leaks and damaged shingles to full roof replacements, we provide fast, reliable service that protects your property and gives you peace of mind.

In addition to roofing, we offer gutters, skylights, ventilation, and siding services. Properly installed gutters prevent water damage, while skylight and ventilation solutions improve natural light, airflow, and energy efficiency. Our siding services enhance curb appeal while reinforcing protection against the elements.

Storm damage? We respond quickly to restore safety and functionality. At Shingle Guard Roofs, we don’t just build and repair roofs—we build trust, ensuring lasting protection and quality for every property.
